project_type: Python Flask web app (TikTok downloader) with Jinja2 templates
test_framework: No formal test framework. Manual verification via Docker build and runtime testing.
test_command: python -c "import app" (basic import check - no pytest suite)
verification_instructions: 1. docker build -t miitokk:test . 2. docker run --rm -p 8080:8080 miitokk:test (manual check) 3. Verify app.py imports cleanly 4. Verify index.html renders without errors
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Python 3.11 available via pyenv. Docker available.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Key constraints from user: do not break TikTok Downloader, do not change download routes, keep navbar/stats/footer, ensure Railway deploy compatibility, ensure Cloudflare proxy compatibility.
key_patterns: Flask app in app.py with routes. Single page app in templates/index.html. CSS split across static/css/ (variables, base, layout, components, animations, drawer, responsive). JS split across static/js/ (config, ui, downloader, photo, effects, main, analytics). Dark theme with red glow cyber aesthetic. Uses CSS variables from variables.css. Components follow .card pattern with glass background and red borders.
directory_structure: Root: app.py (Flask), analytics.py (analytics module), templates/ (Jinja2 HTML), static/css/ (7 CSS files), static/js/ (7 JS files), static/img/ (owner.png), static/icons/ (.gitkeep). Deployment: Dockerfile, Procfile, nixpacks.toml, requirements.txt.
